
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import os,sys,json,base64,hashlib,subprocess,time,resource
client_started=time.monotonic()
REPO=Path('/disk/10tb/home/shmelev/gnnm_iclr_validation_tuning/postsubmission_git')
PHASE=REPO/'experiments_iclr/postsubmission_20260930'
HERE=PHASE/'buddy_gpu77_postfamily_eval_preparation_v4'
OUT=HERE/'root_eval_supervision_20261004_v1'
ADMISSION=HERE/'ROOT_EVALUATION_ADMISSION.json'
payload=json.loads(base64.b64decode(''))
def git(*args):return subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=REPO,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
def safe(path):
 path=Path(path);assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(REPO) and not path.is_symlink()
 for parent in path.parents:
  if parent==REPO:break
  assert not parent.is_symlink()
 return path
def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with safe(path).open('rb') as f:
  while chunk:=f.read(8*1024*1024):h.update(chunk)
 return h.hexdigest()
def descriptor(path):return dict(path=str(path),bytes=safe(path).stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path))
def read(path):return json.loads(safe(path).read_text())
assert Path.cwd().resolve()==REPO and Path(git('rev-parse','--show-toplevel'))==REPO
assert git('branch','--show-current')=='codex/postsubmission-research-20260930' and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only')
uuids=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=uuid','--format=csv,noheader'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()
assert len(uuids)==2 and set(uuids)==set(payload['identity']['physical_GPU_UUIDs'])
existing=[p for p in [ADMISSION,HERE/'root_eval_v1',OUT] if p.exists() or p.is_symlink()]
if existing:
 print(json.dumps(dict(status='EXISTING_ADMISSION_OR_ATTEMPT_PRESERVED_NO_LAUNCH',existing=[str(p) for p in existing],remote_overwrites=False)))
 sys.exit(0)
for entry in payload['source_checks'].values():
 manifest=Path(entry['manifest']['path']);assert sha(manifest)==entry['manifest']['sha256']
 for row in read(manifest)['files']:
  target=manifest.parent/row['path'];assert target.stat().st_size==row['bytes'] and sha(target)==row['sha256']
for entry in payload['ledgers']:
 for key in ['identity','completion','epochs','selected_checkpoint']:
  item=entry[key];path=Path(item['path']);assert path.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(path)==item['sha256']
for item in payload['prior_custody']:
 assert Path(item['path']).stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(Path(item['path']))==item['sha256']
pins=payload['identity']
bound={
 PHASE/'buddy_gpu77_resource_family_launcher_v3/root_family_v2/FAMILY_LAUNCH_RECEIPT.json':'terminal_family_receipt_sha256',
 PHASE/'buddy_gpu77_resource_family_launcher_v3/root_family_v2/RUNTIME_ENVIRONMENT.json':'family_runtime_environment_sha256',
 PHASE/'buddy_gpu77_resource_family_launcher_v3/ROOT_ADMISSION.json':'family_admission_sha256',
 PHASE/'buddy_gpu77_resource_family_launcher_v2/root_resource_v1/RESOURCE_RECEIPT.json':'resource_receipt_sha256',
 PHASE/'gpu77_buddy_numerical_qualification_v2/root_run_v1/CPU_QUALIFICATION.json':'CPU_qualification_sha256',
 PHASE/'buddy_complete_data_cache_preparation_v3/root_run_77_v1/QUALIFICATION.json':'data_qualification_sha256',
 PHASE/'buddy_complete_data_cache_preparation_v3/root_run_77_v1/cache/manifest.json':'cache_manifest_sha256'}
for path,key in bound.items():assert sha(path)==pins[key]
normal=payload['normal_runtime_boundary']['normal_runtime_qualification'];assert sha(Path(normal['path']))==normal['sha256']
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')=='6dad58e56e40175168f6fa2050d0855a97c3ab44' and not git('diff','--name-only')
for item in [payload['lock'],payload['lock_audit'],payload['audit_physical_terminal'],*payload['dependency_records'],*payload['cache_checks']]:
 path=Path(item['path']);assert path.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(path)==item['sha256']
assert all(Path(payload['qualified_runtime_paths'][name]).is_dir() for name in ['TMPDIR','TMP','TEMP','XDG_CACHE_HOME','TORCH_HOME','PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX','NUMBA_CACHE_DIR','MPLCONFIGDIR','CUDA_CACHE_PATH','TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR','TRITON_CACHE_DIR','TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR'])

data_root=PHASE/'buddy_complete_data_cache_preparation_v3/root_run_77_v1'
test_paths=[data_root/'dataset/ogbl_collab/split/time/test.pt',data_root/'cache/test.pt',data_root/'cache/test_manifest.json']
test_paths+=list((PHASE/'buddy_gpu77_resource_family_launcher_v3/root_family_v2/runs').glob('*/final_test.json'))
assert not any(p.exists() or p.is_symlink() for p in test_paths)

gpu_text=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=uuid,name,memory.total,memory.free,memory.used,utilization.gpu','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
gpu_rows=[]
for line in gpu_text.splitlines():
 parts=[part.strip() for part in line.split(',')];assert len(parts)==6
 gpu_rows.append(dict(uuid=parts[0],name=parts[1],memory_total_MiB=int(parts[2]),memory_free_MiB=int(parts[3]),memory_used_MiB=int(parts[4]),utilization_percent=int(parts[5])))
assert len(gpu_rows)==2 and {row['uuid'] for row in gpu_rows}==set(pins['physical_GPU_UUIDs'])
apps=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,used_gpu_memory','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
target=next(row for row in gpu_rows if row['uuid']==pins['scoring_GPU_UUID'])
assert not any(line.split(',')[0].strip()==target['uuid'] for line in apps.splitlines())
assert target['memory_free_MiB']>=0.9*target['memory_total_MiB'] and target['utilization_percent']==0
admission=base64.b64decode(payload['admission_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(admission).hexdigest()==payload['admission_sha256']
runner=base64.b64decode(payload['runner_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(runner).hexdigest()==payload['runner_sha256']
with safe(ADMISSION).open('xb') as h:h.write(admission)
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
source=OUT/'run_heldout_evaluation_once.py'
with source.open('xb') as h:h.write(runner)
with (OUT/'RUNNER.stdout.log').open('x') as stdout,(OUT/'RUNNER.stderr.log').open('x') as stderr:
 proc=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-S','-B',str(source)],cwd=REPO,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
 text=Path(f'/proc/{proc.pid}/stat').read_text();fields=text[text.rfind(')')+2:].split()
 handle=dict(pid=proc.pid,start_ticks=int(fields[19]),argv=['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-S','-B',str(source)])
value=dict(schema='buddy77_authorized_once_heldout_evaluation_detached_launch_v1',UTC=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 status='LAUNCHED_ONCE',HEAD=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),runner_handle=handle,admission=descriptor(ADMISSION),runner_source=descriptor(source),
 registered_output=str(HERE/'root_eval_v1'),registered_supervision=str(OUT),evaluation_once=True,no_retry=True,
 stage='evaluate',evaluate_launched=True,export_executed=False,TEST_payload_access_delegated_to_admitted_stage=True,source_overwrite=False,
 normal_host_mode=True,other_jobs_stopped=False,
 GPU_availability=gpu_rows,compute_apps_observation=apps,scoring_GPU_available_without_stopping_other_jobs=True,
 launch_client_wall_seconds_through_child_start=time.monotonic()-client_started,
 launch_client_peak_RSS_bytes=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss*1024,
 launch_client_CPU_user_seconds=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_utime,
 launch_client_CPU_system_seconds=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_stime,
 launch_client_scope='Source/ledger/checkpoint/cache/dependency byte gates and admission staging; receipt write tail excluded. Runner begins at Popen and a small launch tail overlaps physical runner wall.',
 numerical_retry=False,training_executed=False)
with (OUT/'DETACHED_LAUNCH.json').open('x') as h:json.dump(value,h,indent=2);h.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(value))
